member.name: T:Splat.Builder.AppBuilder
member.summary: Provides a builder for configuring and constructing application dependency resolution and service registration using Splat patterns.
member.remarks: The AppBuilder class enables fluent configuration of dependency resolvers, service modules, and custom registrations for applications using Splat. It supports chaining of registration methods and ensures that core services are registered before building the application instance. AppBuilder is typically used during application startup to configure dependency injection and service location. Thread safety is not guaranteed; configuration should be completed before the application is accessed from multiple threads.
